rationale: Iran strikes US military bases in Bahrain; new direct attack on US forces raises Middle East tension; FBI database hack investigation adds domestic security concern.

top_events.title: Bahrain says Iranian attack causes fire at industrial facility
top_events.label: Iran strikes US military bases in Bahrain
top_events.summary: Iran's IRGC targets US military positions at two bases in Bahrain, causing fire at industrial facility. Direct attack on US forces escalates Middle East tension.

top_events.title: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database
top_events.label: FBI investigates hack of criminal database
top_events.summary: National Crime Information Center database used by federal and local law enforcement reportedly compromised. Domestic security infrastructure breach under investigation.

top_events.title: Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out
top_events.label: FBI most wanted Mexican drug lord arrested
top_events.summary: Fausto Isidro Meza Flores detained after gun fight with Mexican authorities. Major cartel figure captured after more than a decade evading capture.

short_summary: Tech sell-off pushes markets into correction territory

most_significant_event.label: Tech sell-off pushes markets into correction territory
most_significant_event.summary: S&P 500 and Dow Jones entered correction territory as tech stocks declined, directly affecting American retirement accounts and investment portfolios.
